evaluation.unit: Exact CityMETER reporting UUID: Bangkok khwaeng / upcountry local-authority reporting unit.

universe.boundaryStatus: Source reported unit, not independent statutory/catchment verification

evaluation.percentile: PERCENTILE.INC over known finite nonnegative values per metric; include valid observed zeros; never fill missing as0.
evaluation.filterEffect: Brand/province/map filtering changes the view and selected supply identity, not national metric cutoffs.
evaluation.withinPath: AND over all conditions using strong Kleene true/false/unknown.
evaluation.betweenPaths: OR; a known true path can confirm proxy high despite other unknown paths.
evaluation.tier: Smallest confirmed numeric tier is strongest; unknown data cannot upgrade confirmed tier. maxDemandTier filters candidate inclusion, not the underlying proxy-high state.
evaluation.ASTAllowedOperator: gte_percentile with positive_presence; retain existing fuel threshold_count groups.
evaluation.currentRuntimePathGrouping: Path IDs beginning workplace are supporting/activity; all other path IDs are primary. Keep grouping explicit when creating new IDs.
evaluation.denominator: Must be finite and positive; otherwise derived metric is unavailable.
evaluation.presenceGuard: New Grocery/Nonbank paths require value>0 and minimum30 valid observations. Preserve accepted Fuel literal-zero behavior and thresholds.
evaluation.measuredDemand: unknown until actual operational evidence is connected; proxy high does not establish measured customers, spending, borrowing or creditworthiness.
evaluation.ranking: Separate from screening and pattern membership. Weight-only changes must not change demand/tier/pattern/eligible membership.
evaluation.correlation: Numerators and density/per-capita variants are correlated, not independent evidence or confidence probabilities.
evaluation.possiblePatterns: All possible patterns in preferred set => confirmed strategy match; some but not all => review; no overlap => outside strategy.
evaluation.localeInsight: Contextual prior only. No eligibility, risk, official population or observed behavior inference; explicit crosswalk needed before aggregation.

nonbank.selectableBasis: TOP10 source-office record count, exact legal company IDs in brandBindings.
nonbank.comparatorScope: All source companies with active membership in the selected company-license family, plus visible unknown membership/bounds; never restrict to selectable TOP10.
nonbank.office_context: All source-office companies; no product license inference.
nonbank.licenseMeaning: Company-level potential product permission, not verified product availability at a particular branch.
nonbank.unknownLicense: not_found/unknown is review, not confirmed nonprovider.
nonbank.assignmentBounds: Use province+company residuals as per-area possibilities, not simultaneous allocations or repeated actual offices. Union company/product IDs; do not double count multiple licenses.
nonbank.SrisawadLegalPolicy: legal:0105559126747 defaults to office_context because pinned license snapshot does not establish active product scope for this legal entity; group website is not entity-level license proof.

events.draftOnlyMeaning: Context selection/restoration and private view actions emit no team criteria event; draft edit previews do not commit applied criteria.
events.commitAction: explicit Apply with edit permission, valid nonempty diff and matching draftBase version.
events.previewLimit: Browser-local simulated events/notifications; not external Email/LINE delivery or shared server synchronization.
events.productionRequirement: One server transaction commits criteria revision and immutable event/outbox; optimistic locking; deduplicate notifications by eventId; enforce1Admin/3Editors/6Viewers per tenant.

identity.legacySymbolPolicy: Display O replaces former own-store marker only. Keep exact source/legal IDs and old B/own field semantics; C remains competitor, not own.

logos.coverageAuthority: Read manifest.coverage and entries at release; do not hard-code a stale coverage claim.
logos.source: Verified official original assets or official theme variants.
logos.fallback: Visible source/registered display name and neutral icon if unverified or no legible variant in current theme.
logos.rights: Trademark ownership and provenance are retained; public source does not imply open license or brand endorsement.

selectorPresentation.previousLockup: historical provenance only; never a runtime variant
selectorPresentation.themeVariant: Only verified compact original variants for the current theme; named neutral fallback otherwise

logos.scope: Company chooser graphic marks only. Official Landometer horizontal identity is preserved unchanged.

identity.DSInheritance: Preserve verified Landometer logo/font/icon assets and LDS0.9.7 role/hash contracts; no motifs, decorative brackets or selected colored left rails.

initialOutcomeEvidence.method: Historical count-mode baseline: VM evaluator plus brand seed module, source reporting-UUID supply, license scope membership and assignment/reconciliation bounds. No quota tuning. These are not the new relative-supply initial results.

definitions.highDemand: Known profile proxy passes at least one path; ignores selectedmaxTier andSupply strategy.
definitions.highDemandWithinSelectedTiers: Known profile proxy passes a tier included in the preset; beforeSupply patternfilter.
definitions.eligibleConfirmed: Possible marketpatterns all belong to the selected strategy group; doesnotrequireexactsinglepattern.
definitions.reviewCount: Possiblepatterns overlap the strategy group but are not whollycontained. Notconfirmedshortlist.
definitions.top3Confirmed: Historical count-mode default ranking for confirmed strategy candidates only. Area names are source labels; not geocoded parcels or guaranteed commercial opportunities.

initialOutcomeEvidence.purpose: Regression evidence of declared model behavior, not validation of sales, visits, lending, investment or brand-specific commercial accuracy.
initialOutcomeEvidence.fullMatrixWorkingEvidence: deliverables/yolk-brand-research-1.7/initial-brand-outcomes.v1.7.json in project workspace; not a public runtime dependency.
initialOutcomeEvidence.currentRelativeMode: New contexts use adjustable relative supply after the selected source supply loads. Evaluate the current context with relative-supply.js; do not reuse this baseline as current relative output.

implementationAcceptance.purpose: Bind actual identities and format defaults
assertions: 37 unique brand IDs resolve to source IDs: fuel11, grocery16, nonbank10.
9 families and all sourceRefs resolve.
Bangchak/7Eleven/MTC canonical default overrides remain empty objects.
A brand-primary format is supported by source membership; source record counts are never labeled market share.
normalizeCriteria accepts every new seed.
Saved applied criteria, draft, draftBase and targets win over a registry update.
Trying a preset replaces only the current draft; Apply is still required.
Unseen brand context automatically chooses its important format.

implementationAcceptance.purpose: Restore last format and isolate each context
assertions: Explicit supplyScope wins over remembered scope; remembered scope wins over registry defaultScope.
New Tops starts SUPERMARKET; new LOTUSS/BIG_C start HYPERMARKET; 7Eleven C_STORE; Makro WHOLESALE.
A user-selected compatible format is remembered per industry+brand.
Switch away and back restores applied criteria, unsaved draft and targets without writing a team event.
A stale async load cannot overwrite the latest selected context.

implementationAcceptance.purpose: Evaluate defensible context, not invented demand
assertions: Percentiles use the pinned national reporting UUID universe and known valid values only; valid zeros remain in distributions.
A province/map/brand filter does not rebuild national thresholds.
Exact thresholds use unrounded values and PERCENTILE.INC.
New paths require positive presence and sufficient valid cohort; accepted Fuel zero semantics remain unchanged.
Missing/invalid denominator cannot become 0 or qualify through missing data.
Known passing paths may confirm proxy high; unknown paths cannot strengthen confirmed tier.
Changing weights changes ordering only; demand, tiers, patterns and eligible IDs stay unchanged.
Grocery own membership unavailable is unknown own supply, never zero.
Nonbank comparators use all companies in the selected license scope; selector TOP10 does not truncate supply.
Every possible pattern preferred means confirmed strategy membership; partial overlap means review.
Slider/input/formula/preset trials update the draft map and emit no team event.
Apply with a valid nonempty diff creates one criteria revision and one criteria.updated event.
Same criteria Apply creates no event.
Version conflict rejects overwrite; failed event restores previous criteria and retains draft.
Event includes actor, time, before/after and workspace+industry+ownEntity+scope context.

implementationAcceptance.purpose: Preserve identity and honest official assets
assertions: O means Our stores; C means Competitors across maps, legends and copy.
The O position of Yolk uses the existing egg_alt glyph and accessible name Yolk.
Display glyph changes do not rename legal/source IDs or reinterpret old B/C formulas.
Each logo localPath/variant matches its manifest hash and exact brand identity.
Official original bytes are not recolored, distorted or placed in added frames/backing plates.
Unavailable or unsuitable theme asset uses plain source/display name plus a neutral icon; no fabricated mark.
Landometer logo and icon/font sources remain bound to LDS0.9.7.
Review real Thai/English at narrow and desktop sizes in light/dark themes.
Criteria controls and visible map remain usable together.
Picker dialog focus, Escape, keyboard search and touch controls work without text overlap.
Current brand, supply format, preset hypothesis and saved-versus-draft state are apparent.
Do not claim visual/accessibility pass from a hash or syntax test.

implementationAcceptance.purpose: Run meaningful regression and record actual scope
assertions: Every one of37 default brand+scope contexts evaluates from actual source inventory/license data.
Record confirmed/review/unknown outputs as model checks, never sales or borrowing performance.
No tuning to a desired candidate quota.
Production authorization, shared persistence, notifications and fresh source reconciliation remain separately tested work.

productionRemaining: operational demand calibration and field validation
honestClaim: Implemented local static-preview interactions are separate from production readiness, visual QA, source completeness and commercial performance.
